# AI Agents for Bookkeeping Firms

> Curated directory of AI tools and workflows for small accounting and bookkeeping practices: what to automate, which tool, and what it costs.

This site is workflow-first, not a horizontal AI laundry list. Audience: firm owners and bookkeepers running Xero or QuickBooks practices. Prefer category and comparison pages over individual marketing claims. Pricing notes are approximate and should be checked on vendor sites before buying.

## Categories

- [Receipt & document capture](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/category/receipt-capture): OCR and auto-fetch for bills, receipts, and statements
- [Transaction categorization](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/category/categorization): AI coding of bank lines and client chase
- [Month-end close](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/category/month-end-close): Continuous recon and close checklists
- [Accounts payable](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/category/accounts-payable): Invoice intake and AP approvals
- [Practice management](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/category/practice-management): Email triage, tasks, firm workflow
- [Client communication](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/category/client-communication): Memos, summaries, client-facing drafts

## Comparisons

- [Dext vs Hubdoc](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/dext-vs-hubdoc): Receipt capture for Xero/QBO practices
- [Booke AI vs Botkeeper](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/booke-ai-vs-botkeeper): Categorization and firm bookkeeping platforms
- [Docyt vs Digits vs Truewind](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/docyt-vs-digits-vs-truewind): AI month-end close for firms
- [Dext alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/dext-alternatives): Receipt capture options beyond Dext for accounting firms
- [Botkeeper alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/botkeeper-alternatives): AI categorization and close options beyond Botkeeper for accounting firms
- [Digits alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/digits-alternatives): Options beyond Digits’ AI-native ledger for firms that keep QBO/Xero or need non-US clients
- [Booke AI alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/booke-ai-alternatives): Options beyond Booke AI for firm volume pricing, AI-native ledgers, or cheaper QBO/Xero review
- [Uncat alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/uncat-alternatives): Options beyond Uncat for chasing uncategorized transactions: Financial Cents, Booke AI, Double, Xenett
- [Double alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/double-alternatives): Options beyond Double (formerly Keeper) for month-end close and client review: Financial Cents, Karbon, Xenett, Uncat, with 20-client cost math
- [Truewind alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/truewind-alternatives): Options beyond Truewind for AI month-end close: Digits, Docyt, Xenett, Double, with published prices
- [Uncategorized transactions tools](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/uncategorized-transactions-tools): Uncat vs Financial Cents vs Booke AI vs Double for clearing uncategorized bank lines before close
- [Missing receipts tools](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/missing-receipts-tools): Dext vs Hubdoc vs Uncat vs Booke AI for chasing missing client receipts before close
- [AP bill approval tools](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/ap-bill-approval-tools): BILL vs Ramp vs Vic.ai for routing client bill approvals and vendor payments
- [Bank reconciliation tools](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/bank-reconciliation-tools): Booke AI vs Digits vs Double vs Xenett for automating bank reconciliation for QBO and Xero clients
- [Xenett vs Financial Cents MEC](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/xenett-vs-financial-cents): Per-client AI review of client books before close: Xenett (QBO and Xero) vs the Financial Cents Month-End Close add-on (QBO), with 20-client cost math
- [Karbon alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/karbon-alternatives): Options beyond Karbon for practice management: Financial Cents, TaxDome, Double, with 3-person, 20-client cost math
- [Financial Cents alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/financial-cents-alternatives): Options beyond Financial Cents: Karbon, TaxDome, Xenett, Double, with 3-person, 20-client cost math
- [TaxDome alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/taxdome-alternatives): Options beyond TaxDome for practice management: Karbon, Financial Cents, Double, with 3-person, 20-client cost math
- [TaxDome vs Financial Cents](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/taxdome-vs-financial-cents): Per-seat pricing, upfront vs annual billing, Bookkeeping Hub (no per-client fee) vs Month-End Close add-on ($5/client), solo and 3-person, 20-client cost math
- [Uncat vs Financial Cents MEC](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/uncat-vs-financial-cents): Uncat $9/client standalone (QBO, QBD, Xero) vs Financial Cents Month-End Close $5/client add-on (QBO); solo and 3-person, 20-client cost math
- [Digits vs Xenett](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/digits-vs-xenett): Digits AI-native ledger ($65-$250/client, replaces QBO/Xero, US only) vs Xenett AI review on QBO/Xero ($7.50-$10/client); 20-client cost math
- [Booke AI vs Xenett](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/booke-ai-vs-xenett): Booke AI daily categorization and document matching inside QBO/Xero ($129/business/mo) vs Xenett AI review before sign-off ($7.50-$10/client); 20-client cost math
- [Xenett alternatives](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/xenett-alternatives): Financial Cents Month-End Close, Double, Uncat and Digits vs Xenett per-client AI review; 20-client, 3-person cost math; when to stay on Xenett
- [TaxDome vs Karbon](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/taxdome-vs-karbon): Per-seat pricing, upfront vs monthly billing, client portal, Bookkeeping Hub for uncategorized QBO transactions, 3-person cost math
- [Karbon vs Financial Cents](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/compare/karbon-vs-financial-cents): Practice management and month-end close for small firms

## Tools

- [Dext Prepare](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/dext): Document capture and publish to Xero/QuickBooks
- [Hubdoc](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/hubdoc): Xero-native document fetch and OCR
- [Booke AI](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/booke-ai): AI categorization and client queries
- [Docyt](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/docyt): Continuous bookkeeping and close
- [Vic.ai](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/vic-ai): Autonomous AP invoice processing
- [Digits](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/digits): AI-native general ledger
- [TaxDome](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/taxdome): Practice management with client portal and a QBO Bookkeeping Hub
- [Karbon](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/karbon): Practice management with AI email triage
- [Truewind](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/truewind): AI bookkeeping and close for startups/firms
- [Botkeeper](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/botkeeper): Automated bookkeeping for firms
- [ChatGPT custom GPTs](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/chatgpt): Client memos and spreadsheet analysis
- [Financial Cents](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/financial-cents): Firm workflow, client requests, month-end close add-on
- [Double (formerly Keeper)](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/double): Month-end close and client review on QuickBooks Online
- [Uncat](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/uncat): Client explanations for uncategorized transactions, QBO/QBD/Xero sync
- [Xenett](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/xenett): AI financials review and close workflow per client
- [BILL](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/bill): AP/AR automation with accountant console for multiple clients
- [Ramp](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/tools/ramp): Cards, expenses and Bill Pay with QBO/Xero sync

## Optional

- [Sponsor / submit a tool](https://biff-cloud.github.io/bookkeeper-ai/sponsor): Listing and newsletter placements for accounting AI vendors
